how: race_gear.py: Dwarf is Alliance, so it can't wear the Horde rewards of the preset's level60_phase0_arms. It wears level60_phase0_arms_alliance, the same set with those slots re-ranked at a Alliance race (bis_phase0.sh RANK_ONLY SLOTS), kept by the rule, without a sim. On it, Dwarf hit 9.3% against the 8% yellow cap, the set's own hit 8.3%: 1% (10 budget points) re-spent over the set's shares at the 1b prices (Strength 42.3%, CritRating 29.0%, AttackPowerBoth 15.2%, Agility 13.5%). Hit and crit are one pool for the gear, so each is written once. Dwarf 999.2 with the set, 1005.0 with the swap; gain.se is the paired error (the same seeded fights), 0.58 unpaired.
